item.name: command logs of a test session

request.description: Returns a signed URL to download the full commands.zip for the session. The zip contains the per-page command log JSON files at the root, plus per-annotation command log JSON files (when present) under an `annotations/` subdirectory. To fetch a single annotation's commands inline (without downloading the zip), use the v1 endpoint with `annotationId`.
